entities.summary: Midwestern hip-hop, also known as Midwestern rap, is a style of hip-hop that originated in the Midwest region of the United States. The genre initially gained popularity in the mid-1990s thanks to extremely fast rappers known as "choppers", such as Bone Thugs-n-Harmony (Cleveland), Twista and Da Brat (Chicago), Tech N9ne, Atmosphere (Minneapolis), and Eminem (Detroit).
